text.en: You are in the driver's cab of an electric locomotive, standing at the platform with the brakes on. Let's get the train moving. Drag with the mouse to look around.
You are in the driver's cab of an electric locomotive, standing at the platform with the brakes on. Let's get the train moving. Drag one finger on the screen to look around, pinch to zoom.
Raise the pantograph so the loco can draw power from the overhead wire. Watch the OHE voltage gauge rise to about 25 kV.
Raise the pantograph so the loco can draw power from the overhead wire: tap ⋯ (More), then Pantograph. Watch the OHE voltage gauge rise to about 25 kV.
Close the main circuit breaker (VCB). The VCB OPEN lamp goes out and the transformer starts humming.
Close the main circuit breaker (VCB): tap ⋯, then Main breaker. The VCB OPEN lamp goes out and the transformer starts humming.
Turn on the headlight. Press once for dim, twice for bright.
Turn on the headlight: tap ⋯, then Headlight. Tap once for dim, twice for bright.
Set the reverser to Forward. It decides which way the traction motors drive the train.
Set the reverser to Forward: tap ⋯, then F on the reverser. It decides which way the traction motors drive the train.
Check the signal ahead. You may only start on a yellow, double yellow or green aspect. Red means stop: wait for it to clear.
Check the signal ahead (the coloured dot in the strip at the top). You may only start on a yellow, double yellow or green aspect. Red means stop: wait for it to clear.
Release the automatic train brake: press ; until the handle reaches Running and the brake pipe (BP) needle climbs to about 5 kg/cm2.
Release the train brake: slide the BRAKE slider on the right edge up to Run, and watch the brake pipe (BP) needle climb to about 5 kg/cm2.
Release the independent loco brake with [ until the SA9 handle is fully off.
Release the loco brake: tap ⋯, then Release next to Loco brake until it shows 0%.
Sound the horn before moving off to warn anyone on or near the track.
Sound the horn before moving off to warn anyone on or near the track: tap the horn button (hold it for a long blast).
Apply power gently: press D to notch up two or three notches. A long train takes a few seconds to start rolling - watch the speedometer.
Apply power gently: slide the POWER slider on the left edge up two or three notches. A long train takes a few seconds to start rolling - watch the speed.
Stay under the speed limit shown in the red circle on the HUD and on the driver display. Keep driving for a little while.
Stay under the speed limit shown in the red circle in the strip at the top. Keep driving for a little while.
Now stop: notch down to 0 with A, then apply the train brake gently with ' (one or two service positions). Release the brake once you have stopped.
Now stop: slide POWER down to 0, then pull the BRAKE slider down one or two steps. Slide it back up to Run once you have stopped.
You've driven your first train! Press Esc any time for the menu, F1 for all the controls.
You've driven your first train! Tap Menu any time for the menu and settings.
